{{Top|leg}}
An advancement on the secret compartments favored by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] across the galaxy, '''cloaked smuggling compartments''' were far more elusive than traditional models. Lined with [[Nightshadow anti-sensor treatment|nightshadow]], these [[Smuggling compartment/Legends|smuggling compartments]] could evade all but the most advanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans. [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] produced such a compartment, the [[Nightshadow compartment liner]].<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
